subject: [PATCH 3/9] mm/gup: convert follow_page_mask() to return a long

2026-11-23.patch_summary: This patch changes the return type of follow_page_mask() and its helpers from a struct page pointer to a long integer. The new return value can be an error code, 0 indicating no page found, or 1 with the page stored in a pages[0] slot. This allows the function to carry a page count rather than a single page pointer.
